mapper.select: select i.*, d.rental_days, h.rental_hours from invoice i left outer join invoice_daily d on i.id = d.invoice_id left outer join invoice_hourly h on i.id = h.invoice_id order by billed_date desc

select i.*, it.name_type, d.rental_days, h.rental_hours from invoice i left outer join invoice_daily d on i.id = d.invoice_id left outer join invoice_hourly h on i.id = h.invoice_id join invoice_type it on i.invoice_type = it.code where i.id like '%${pattern}%' or i.customer_name like '%${pattern}%' or i.room_id like '%${pattern}%' or i.billed_date like '%${pattern}%'

select i.*, it.name_type, d.rental_days, h.rental_hours from invoice i left outer join invoice_daily d on i.id = d.invoice_id left outer join invoice_hourly h on i.id = h.invoice_id join invoice_type it on i.invoice_type = it.code where i.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into invoice(id, invoice_type, room_id, price, customer_name, billed_date) values(#{id}, #{invoiceType.code}, #{roomId}, #{price}, #{customerName}, #{billedDate});
mapper.update: update Invoice set room_id = #{room_id}, price = #{price}, customer_name = #{customer_name}, billed_date = #{billed_date} where id = #{id}
